label: Integrated Buddhist Noble Truths and cessation of desire into Western metaphysics
description: Arthur Schopenhauer synthesized Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha)'s framework with contrasting philosophical traditions to produce a novel unified philosophical system.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Siddhartha Gautama (The Buddha)'s perspective to Arthur Schopenhauer's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Eastern & Axial Traditions across history into the 19th Century Divergences.
